title: Malign swarm-like NHI in DeLonge's books, Elizondo's hints and the Cryptoterrestrial Conundrum

tellings.quote: The thing basically in the Tom Deong books or things that Alzando has hinted at. Um you know they've drawn and even the book uh Crypto's conundrum. Uhhuh. It's they all address this idea of like the the bad NHI or the malign.

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that several sources share one idea: some NHI, short for non-human intelligence, may be hostile, and may act like a swarm. He says this idea runs through books by Tom DeLonge, who has written about UFOs, through hints from Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks about UFOs, and through a book called the Cryptoterrestrial Conundrum. If true, it would mean that not everything behind these encounters means humans well.
